Subject: Connector access and SOC2 evidence transfer steps

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — GRCFlow is excited about the planned connector into Redwood Inference for automated SOC2 evidence harvesting (audit logs, user access exports, and config snapshots). To get us into a short pilot we need two things from your side: a service account (or S3 credentials for evidence drop) and a short MTM (mutual action plan) so our onboarding & pen-test partner can schedule the evidence pull windows.

High level requested steps:
- Provide read-only service account (GCP) scoped to audit logs + bucket access; see attached instructions.
- Whitelist our collector IPs (attached CSV) on any internal infra egress rules.
- Confirm retention windows and any PII redaction rules we should apply.
- Sign the small SOW for the connector and pen-test coordination so PenSecure can proceed with their timeline.

I attached our connector onboarding checklist and the whitelist CSV. PenSecure (cc'd in a later message) will send their SOW and timeline; we expect ~3 business days for the initial pull and then regular weekly sync for 30 days for the pilot.

Questions for you now: are there any approvals needed from Redwood security or procurement to exchange the SOW and schedule the pen test? Also, is there a preferred DocuSign contract contact?

Best,
Elena Morales
Partnerships, GRCFlow
elena@grcflow.io
